mainEntity.name: Does a second-story addition increase property value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a well-planned and executed second-story addition typically increases property value. By adding significant square footage, bedrooms, and bathrooms, you enhance your home's functionality and appeal, making it more desirable to potential buyers. The exact increase in value depends on factors like the quality of the work, the added amenities, and how the renovation aligns with other homes in your specific neighborhood. It's often considered one of the home improvement projects that yields a strong return on investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: A well-executed second-story addition generally increases property value by adding square footage and amenities. Return on investment depends on quality and local market.
